name: toaster
title: Cloudlet Toaster
description: Client Provider/Toaster adapter with shadcn theme tokens. The application explicitly owns its @cloudlet/toast controller.
docs: Import Toaster into a client owner and pass its controller. Import @cloudlet/toast/styles.css once before the local toaster.css (the wrapper already imports both). The owner creates/disposes its controller; do not share one across requests. See https://cloudlet.dev/toaster/docs for lifecycle, theme and SSR.
